existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Payment or tender of fees as precondition to certified copies
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For certified copies, the requester must pay or tender the prescribed copying and certifying fees as a condition of the officer's duty to furnish them.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: shall furnish copies certified to be correct to any person who requests them and pays or tenders such fees as may be prescribed for the service of copying and certifying.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Payment gate is expressed only for certified copies under NRS 239.030; Chapter 239 authorizes no general advance deposit or prepayment before search for ordinary copies.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Copy fee limited to actual cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A governmental entity may charge a fee for a copy, but the fee must not exceed the actual cost to provide the copy unless a specific statute or regulation sets the fee.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Entity provides a copy of a public record
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: ceiling: actual cost of providing the copy
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Except as otherwise provided in this subsection, a governmental entity may charge a fee for providing a copy of a public record. Such a fee must not exceed the actual cost to the governmental entity to provide the copy of the public record unless a specific statute or regulation sets a fee that the governmental entity must charge for the copy.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Permission to charge plus its actual-cost ceiling kept in one row. City sets the operative per-copy rate under the actual-cost ceiling; a more specific statute/regulation can override the ceiling. Added 1997; amended 2013.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: 'Actual cost' means direct cost of providing the copy (ink, toner, paper, media, postage) and excludes any cost the entity incurs regardless of whether a copy is requested.
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: ‘Actual cost’ means the direct cost incurred by a governmental entity in the provision of a public record, including, without limitation, the cost of ink, toner, paper, media and postage. The term does not include a cost that a governmental entity incurs regardless of whether or not a person requests a copy of a particular public record.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Definition the fee engine branches on: the 'regardless of request' exclusion bars charging for staff/labor time and overhead. Reinforced by 2019 SB287, which also repealed the former extraordinary-use personnel fee (NRS 239.055).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: No fee where statute/regulation requires free copy
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A governmental entity must not charge a fee for a copy if a specific statute or regulation requires it to provide the copy without charge.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: A specific statute or regulation requires the copy to be provided free
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: A governmental entity shall not charge a fee for providing a copy of a public record if a specific statute or regulation requires the governmental entity to provide the copy without charge.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Third sentence of NRS 239.052(1); a fee-suppression branch triggered by other free-copy mandates (e.g., NV-0027).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Discretionary fee waiver by written policy
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A governmental entity may waive all or part of a copy fee if it adopts a written waiver policy and posts a legible sign or notice of the policy's terms at each office providing copies.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Entity has adopted a written waiver policy and posted notice
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: A governmental entity may waive all or a portion of a charge or fee for a copy of a public record if the governmental entity: (a) Adopts a written policy to waive all or a portion of a charge or fee for a copy of a public record; and (b) Posts, in a conspicuous place at each office in which the governmental entity provides copies of public records, a legible sign or notice that states the terms of the policy.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Waiver is discretionary and conditioned on a posted written policy.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Law library copy fee ceiling of 50 cents per page
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: The fee for a copy of a record in the custody of a governmental law library must not exceed 50 cents per page.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Copy provided from a record in a governmental law library's custody
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: The fee for providing a copy of a public book or record in the custody of a law library operated by a governmental entity must not exceed 50 cents per page.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Record/entity-specific per-page ceiling; city law library sets the operative rate up to $0.50/page.

existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: For a copy of a certified-court-reporter transcript of an administrative proceeding, the entity must charge, on top of actual medium cost, a per-page fee equal to the court reporter's contract per-page fee, and remit that amount to the reporter.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Person requests a copy of a transcribed administrative-proceeding transcript
existing_fee_payment_rules.clock_spec: fixed: court reporter's contract per-page fee + actual medium cost
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: If a person requests a copy of a transcript of an administrative proceeding that has been transcribed by a certified court reporter, a governmental entity shall charge, in addition to the actual cost of the medium in which the copy of the transcript is provided, a fee for each page provided which is equal in amount to the fee per page charged by the court reporter for the copy of the transcript, as set forth in the contract between the governmental entity and the court reporter.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Special-record fee; the per-page value is fixed by the entity-reporter contract, not freely set by the city. An exception to the general actual-cost ceiling.

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Additional fee for geographic information system data
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: A fee for information from a geographic information system may include, in addition to actual medium cost, the reasonable costs of data gathering/entry, database maintenance, hardware, software, quality control, and consultation with personnel.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Request for information from a geographic information system
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: A fee for the provision of information from a geographic information system may include, in addition to the actual cost of the medium in which the information is provided, the reasonable costs related to: (a) The gathering and entry of data into the system; (b) Maintenance and updating of the database of the system; (c) Hardware; (d) Software; (e) Quality control; and (f) Consultation with personnel of the governmental entity.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Special-record fee permitting recovery of 'reasonable costs' beyond actual cost for GIS data — a statutory exception to the actual-cost ceiling; no numeric value (soft-standard).

existing_fee_payment_rules.legal_concept: Certified copies for VA benefit eligibility furnished without charge
existing_fee_payment_rules.atomic_rule: When a public record copy is required by the federal Department of Veterans Affairs to determine benefit eligibility, the custodian must provide a certified copy without charge to the applicant, their representative, or the VA.
existing_fee_payment_rules.trigger: Copy required by the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs for benefit-eligibility determination
existing_fee_payment_rules.source_language: Whenever a copy of any public record is required by the Department of Veterans Affairs to be used in determining the eligibility of any person to participate in benefits made available by the Department of Veterans Affairs, the official charged with the custody of such public record shall, without charge, provide the applicant for the benefit or any person acting on behalf of the applicant or the representative of the Department of Veterans Affairs with a certified copy or copies of such records.
existing_fee_payment_rules.notes: Requester/purpose-specific fee exemption (a mandatory free-copy statute that triggers NV-0022).
